say:0:1622540001:1.text: The air is thick with the scent of rot and sorrow—a silent mourning that's lasted far too long.
say:0:1622540001:1.source_cn: 腐朽与哀伤交织的余味浸透了每一寸空气，那是无言的悲鸣，...
say:0:1622540001:1.male: The air is thick with the scent of rot and sorrow—a silent mourning that's lasted far too long.
say:0:1622540001:1.female: The air is thick with the scent of rot and sorrow—a silent mourning that's lasted far too long.

say:1:1622540002:1.text: The giant tree, Talking Root, stands before you, wordless. Its heavy branches hang low, weighed down by years of grief.
say:1:1622540002:1.source_cn: 庞大的巨树——根语，枝叶低垂，沉默地矗立在你们面前。
say:1:1622540002:1.male: The giant tree, Talking Root, stands before you, wordless. Its heavy branches hang low, weighed down by years of grief.
say:1:1622540002:1.female: The giant tree, Talking Root, stands before you, wordless. Its heavy branches hang low, weighed down by years of grief.

say:3:1622540003:1.text: Hey there... it's Jorge. Years ago, I got lost out here, and you and Perri helped me find my way.
say:3:1622540003:1.source_cn: 树先生，我是豪尔赫。很多年前，我曾迷失在森林中，是你和...

say:5:1622540004:1.text: And it's me, Saro. I'm the one who burned your bark back then. Don't know if you remember.
say:5:1622540004:1.source_cn: 还有我，老家伙，我叫萨略。那个用火焰烫伤过你的人类，不...

say:7:1622540005:1.text: Talking Root doesn't speak, but one of its sagging branches lifts ever so slightly.
say:7:1622540005:1.source_cn: 根语依然沉默，但低垂的枝条似乎不易察觉地抬高了一点点。
say:7:1622540005:1.male: Talking Root doesn't speak, but one of its sagging branches lifts ever so slightly.
say:7:1622540005:1.female: Talking Root doesn't speak, but one of its sagging branches lifts ever so slightly.

say:9:1622540006:1.text: If Perri were here, he wouldn't want you shutting yourself away like this. He'd want you to heal.
say:9:1622540006:1.source_cn: 要是皮瑞先生还活着，他绝不会愿意看到你现在这样，把自己...

say:10:1622540007:1.text: Everything he did... he did it hoping you'd get better and keep watching over this forest.
say:10:1622540007:1.source_cn: 他把生命留在这片森林，是希望你能好起来，继续守护这片森林。

say:12:1622540008:1.text: Perri... If I hadn't been lost to the corruption... I could've saved him. And all the others I hurt...
say:12:1622540008:1.source_cn: 皮瑞……要是我清醒着……一定能救他……我还杀了那么多无...

say:13:1622540009:1.text: I can't live with this. This guilt... it's too much.
say:13:1622540009:1.source_cn: 这份罪孽……太沉重……我无法释怀……

say:15:1622540010:1.text: It wasn't your fault, Talking Root. That corruption twisted everything you felt and saw. If you stay buried in guilt, you'll only go further from what Perri wanted for you.
say:15:1622540010:1.source_cn: 那不是你的错，根语。是那股黑暗力量蒙蔽了你。如果你一直...

say:17:1622540011:1.text: Listen, big guy! None of us can change what happened. But we can face what comes next, together!
say:17:1622540011:1.source_cn: 听着，大家伙！过去的事，谁也扳不回来了。但往后的事，咱...

say:18:1622540012:1.text: I might be an old grump, but I stick to my word! You've got me, and you've got Jorge, whether you like it or not!
say:18:1622540012:1.source_cn: 我萨略，别的不行，但说到做到！以后，我跟你，还有老糊涂...

say:19:1622540013:1.text: Anyone tries to bring that corruption back, they'll have to answer to us first. How's that sound, Talking Root?
say:19:1622540013:1.source_cn: 有人敢来森林撒野，传播那该死的腐化，我保管不答应！怎么...

choice_prompt:20:1622540013.text: Anyone tries to bring that corruption back, they'll have to answer to us first. How's that sound, Talking Root?
choice_prompt:20:1622540013.source_cn: 有人敢来森林撒野，传播那该死的腐化，我保管不答应！怎么样，根语！

say:21:1622540014:1.text: Talking Root, we'll visit you. Talk to you. Keep you company. Perri did that for you, and we can do it too.
say:21:1622540014:1.source_cn: 根语，我们会常来看你，跟你说话，告诉你森林外面的事情，...

say:22:1622540015:1.text: And who knows... maybe we'll even track down some of Bibi's descendants. Bring a little life back into this place.
say:22:1622540015:1.source_cn: 也许……也许还能帮你找找包包的后代们，让这片森林重新热...

say:24:1622540016:1.text: Hey, I'm Colm, Sheriff of Starfall County. I'll take care of the investigation. The people who brought that corruption here won't get away with it. And I'll make sure everyone in Starfall County learns the truth!
say:24:1622540016:1.source_cn: 根语先生，我是星湖郡治安官科尔姆，请放心，我将着手追查...

say:26:1622540017:1.text: Friends... you called me Talking Root...

say:27:1622540018:1.text: Perri gave me that name. It's been so long since anyone spoke to me like that. Thank you... all of you.
say:27:1622540018:1.source_cn: 皮瑞给我起的名字……已经……很久很久没有生命这样呼唤我...

say:29:1622540019:1.text: Like waking from a long and heavy slumber, something begins to stir within the giant tree's branches—something warm and alive.
say:29:1622540019:1.source_cn: 如同从一场漫长而沉重的冬眠中苏醒，似乎有某种温暖的存在...
say:29:1622540019:1.male: Like waking from a long and heavy slumber, something begins to stir within the giant tree's branches—something warm and alive.
say:29:1622540019:1.female: Like waking from a long and heavy slumber, something begins to stir within the giant tree's branches—something warm and alive.

say:31:1622540020:1.text: That's more like it! Chin up, old fellow! From now on, this is our meeting spot!
say:31:1622540020:1.source_cn: 这就对了嘛！振作起来，老伙计！以后这儿，就是咱们碰头的...

say:32:1622540021:1.text: Come on, young mage. We've got work to do. Time to make a plan for tracking down those rotten scoundrels who started all this!
say:32:1622540021:1.source_cn: 年轻人，咱们得好好盘算盘算，怎么把那些散播腐化的混蛋揪出来！

say:34:1622540022:1.text: You agree with Saro, and promise to contact the Serene Lyceum to give Professor Perri the proper burial he deserves.
say:34:1622540022:1.source_cn: 你同意了萨略的提议，并表示将联系莱希拉姆学院，为皮瑞老...
say:34:1622540022:1.male: You agree with Saro, and promise to contact the Serene Lyceum to give Professor Perri the proper burial he deserves.
say:34:1622540022:1.female: You agree with Saro, and promise to contact the Serene Lyceum to give Professor Perri the proper burial he deserves.

narration:35:1622540023:1.text: Jorge and Saro both nod with a smile. Talking Root's leaves rustle softly overhead, as if celebrating this newfound friendship...

choice:20:1:2.text: Me too. No way I'm letting that happen again!
choice:20:1:2.male: Me too. No way I'm letting that happen again!
choice:20:1:2.female: Me too. No way I'm letting that happen again!
